headline: Oil Gains on Reports US May Resume Military Strikes Against Iran
summary: Brent crude for December settlement added 1% to $116.06 a barrel amid signs that the United States may resume military strikes against Iran.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East heavily influence crude oil pricing due to potential supply disruptions in key shipping lanes like the Strait of Hormuz.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: The threat of military conflict involving major oil producers raises supply disruption fears.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Geopolitical escalation risks curtailing petroleum exports from the Middle East, prompting traders to reprice supply scarcity.
